data.text: Miri induction IV dosing at Weeks 0, 4, and 8; miri maintenance SC dosing from Week 12.
For details about TZP dose escalation, see Section 6.1.4.2.
Visits 2 through 15 will be conducted Q4W. During the Maintenance Period, some of the visits will be remote; for details, see the SoA (Section 1.3).
Visit 801 will occur 4 weeks after the last treatment visit or ED.
For definition of the primary endpoints, see Section 3.
The ICF must be signed before any protocol-specific tests or procedures are performed. See Section 10.1.3 for additional details.
Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria before randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.
Demographics includes ethnicity (where permissible), year of birth, sex assigned at birth, and race.
Collect all ongoing conditions and relevant past medical and surgical history.
Collect additional data for UC and comorbidities of interest, including weight-related hypertension, T2DM, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, or cardiovascular disease.
Collect all data for ongoing medications at the time of consent and concomitant medications of interest (Section 6.9.1).
Any events that occur after signing the informed consent are considered AEs as defined in Section 10.3. Additional data are collected for certain AEs. See Section 8.3.3 for AESIs.
Pre-colonoscopy instructions include daily eDiary compliance, dates, and bowel preparation/procedure.

The complete physical examination excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations, unless clinically indicated. All remaining physical examinations throughout the study should include a symptom-directed physical evaluation, as well as an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. See Section 8.2.1. Assess for TB risk factors, and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including exam of peripheral lymph nodes (see Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).

Symptom-directed physical assessment: Perform as indicated based on participant status and standard of care. May be performed by a qualified personnel per local regulations. Every symptom-directed examination should also include an examination of the heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. At least every third month after screening, assess for TB risk factors, and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.10).
Vital signs include pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature. Measured after participant has been sitting at least 5 minutes. See Sections 8.2.2 and 10.9.
Collect ECG before blood samples for laboratory testing. Local ECGs may be repeated at the investigator's discretion at any visit. See Section 8.2.3.
Lifestyle counseling (diet, exercise, and lifestyle goals): *The window period for these visits should be up to 14 days. See Sections 5.3.1 and 5.3.2.
If HCV antibody test is positive, perform HCV RNA testing. See Section 8.2.12.
If anti-HBc is positive, perform HBV DNA testing. See Section 8.2.11.
HBV DNA: Only for participants who are anti-HBc positive at Visit 1. See Section 8.2.11.

TB test: Participants who had a tuberculin skin test (TST) must have the test read 48 to 72 hours after placement. The test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained professional and results must be presented to the site prior to first dose of study interventions. Local staff must be qualified to administer and interpret the test per the local regulation. See Sections 8.2.10 and 10.2.
eGFR calculated using CKD-EPI Cystatin C Equation 2012 (NKF [WWW]).

PK samples (mirikizumab; pre-dose): Collect samples before the dosing, if dosing is scheduled. Collect additional samples at specified times relative to onset of hypersensitivity events (Section 10.2.1).
Gray-shaded columns in the SoA tables represent telehealth visits.
Procedures for screening (Visit 1) may be conducted over more than 1 day as long as all activities are completed within the allowable visit tolerance.

The SoA described below should be followed for all participants enrolled in Study AMCD. However, for those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, please refer to Section 10.16 for additional guidance.

DXA scan: If not completed, will not be considered a protocol deviation. Participants should fast for at least 8 hours without eating or drinking (except water) before each DXA scan. No water should be consumed within 2 hours before each DXA scan.
DXA scan at ED (*): At ED, repeat if more than 3 months have passed since the last scan.
FSH: * Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Section 8.2.6.
HBV DNA in SoA Table 2: Only for participants who are anti-HBc positive at Visit 1. See Section 8.2.11.

PK samples (mirikizumab and tirzepatide; pre-dose) in SoA Table 2: Collect samples before the dosing, if dosing is scheduled. Collect additional samples at specified times relative to onset of hypersensitivity events (Section 10.2.1).
Lifestyle counseling in SoA Table 2: *The window period for these visits should be up to 14 days. See Sections 5.3.1 and 5.3.2.

data.text: Patients with UC should undergo colorectal cancer surveillance starting at 8 years after disease onset, as they are at higher risk of developing colorectal cancer. This timing allows for optimal prevention and early detection of colorectal cancer or dysplasia. (Rationale for addition to Inclusion Criterion 4)
